681-5413-6621-8345.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Mirrorpool can tap to produce at least {2}{C}
681-5413-6621-8345.description:
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate any number of lands you control except Mirrorpool by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land other than Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 3 until Mirrorpool is the only land you control.
Activate Mirrorpool's second ability by paying {2}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, copying Splendid Reclamation.
Resolve the Splendid Reclamation copy, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
Repeat from step 2.

2226-4443-6751.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-4443-6751.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Starfield Vocalist.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Riftwing Cloudskate by paying its mana cost.
When Riftwing Cloudskate enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

1722-2034-3583-7286.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1722-2034-3583-7286.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
When the Tentacle dies, South Wind Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Oloro triggers, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2

323-443-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
323-443-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble, Magus of the Bridge and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Magus of the Bridge ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2445-5254-6495.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
2445-5254-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
2445-5254-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2178-2527-3143-8095.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one counter on a permanent you control except Xavier Sal.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Xavier Sal.
You control at least one additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate that has no more than one +1/+1 counter on it.
2178-2527-3143-8095.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from the additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate if it has one, or any counter from another permanent you control otherwise.
Xavier Sal triggers, causing it and all other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and gain undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability, causing you to populate.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the additional Human, Fungus and/or Pirate.
When the creature dies, its undying ability and Xavier Sal trigger.
Resolve the creature's undying trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Xavier Sal trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

62-833-3827-5621.notablePrerequisites:
Soul of Windgrace can attack without taking damage.
Savage Ventmaw can attack without taking damage.
62-833-3827-5621.description:
Declare Savage Ventmaw and Soul of Windgrace as attackers.
When they attack, Savage Ventmaw and Soul of Windgrace trigger.
Resolve the Savage Ventmaw trigger, adding six mana that you will not lose this turn as steps and phases end.
Resolve the Soul of Windgrace trigger, returning Arid Archway from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Arid Archway enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
In your next main phase, cast Waves of Aggression from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {3}{R/W}{R/W} and discarding Arid Archway, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn, and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1183-2829-6972.easyPrerequisites: You are able to kill Arcbound Ravager such that it won't have a -1/-1 counter on it when it dies.
1183-2829-6972.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Pentavus.
When Pentavus dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.
Kill Arcbound Ravager.
When Arcbound Ravager dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Arcbound Ravager from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will have no counters on it due to its modular ability.
Arcbound Ravager dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness
Repeat from step 2.
1183-2829-6972.notes: This combo will end the game in a draw if it isn't interacted with, as it creates a mandatory infinite loop.

1671-2092-4954.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has at least 7 power.
1671-2092-4954.description:
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding two mana.
Activate Silvanus's Invoker by paying {1}, untapping Simic Growth Chamber and causing it to become an 8/8 Elemental with trample and haste in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite mana, you may tap and untap any other land(s) you control, and if you control lands that can produce {R} and {G}, use the mana to activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-5078-7729.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Harnfel by discarding a card, exiling the top two cards of your library and allowing you to cast them this turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {1}.
The Vision and Scarlet Witch triggers, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3532-4908-5078-7742.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-4908-5078-7742.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Machinesmith Automaton triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Machinesmith Automaton.
Repeat.

4050-4052-5078-7028.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
When the Spirits enter, Kindred Discovery triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards, including Sensei's Divining Top.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2374-5256-7084.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Maja triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1479-2638-2841-6155.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Arid Mesa.
Your life total is at least 2.
1479-2638-2841-6155.description:
Fetch a land using Arid Mesa.
When the fetched land enters, Tireless Tracker and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Tireless Tracker trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Tireless Tracker triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-1746-6972.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Accomplished Automaton.
When Accomplished Automaton dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Accomplished Automaton enters, its fabricate ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Accomplished Automaton trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

985-2034-5220.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken artifact creature that can be cast using {C}{C} or less.
985-2034-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Siren of the Silent Song

1557-2757-3525.description:
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Siren of the Silent Song, untapping the Island.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Siren of the Silent Song.
Siren of the Silent Song triggers, causing each opponent to discard a card and mill a card.
Repeat.

5657-6108-6489.manaNeeded: {4}{C}{C}{C}{G/U}{G/U} plus enough mana to cast the additional Eldrazi spell
5657-6108-6489.notablePrerequisites: You have another Eldrazi creature card in hand.
5657-6108-6489.description:
Cast any other Eldrazi except Drowner of Truth by paying its mana cost, triggering Ulalek.
Holding priority, cast Drowner of Truth by paying {4}{C}{G/U}{G/U}.
Drowner of Truth and Ulalek trigger.
Resolve the Ulalek trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy all spells you control and then copy all activated and triggered abilities you control, ensuring to put Drowner of Truth's trigger on top of Ulalek's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Drowner of Truth's trigger, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the copy of Ulalek's trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy all spells you control and then copy all activated and triggered abilities you control, ensuring to put Drowner of Truth's trigger on top of Ulalek's trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

1445-4871-5477-5686.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-5477-5686.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

575-1947-5971.easyPrerequisites: ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
575-1947-5971.description:
Activate Reckless Barbarian by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
When Reckless Barbarian dies, Yedora triggers, returning Reckless Barbarian from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Reckless Barbarian enters the battlefield, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Reckless Barbarian by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Reckless Barbarian face-up.
Repeat.

4365-4659-5365-5494.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact
4365-4659-5365-5494.description:
Activate Lonis by paying {2} and sacrificing another artifact.
If the artifact was a Clue, Lonis' third ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Lonis ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating two Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Clue, adding {C}{C}.
Lonis' third ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on any other creature you control.
Repeat.

2034-3994-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Precursor Golem, adding {C}{C}.
When Precursor Golem dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Precursor Golem from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Precursor Golem enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2358-3260-4893-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's third ability by paying {W}, causing you to gain five life.
Activate Blood Celebrant by paying three life, adding {W}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite life, you may use Blood Celebrant to get infinite colored mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's other abilities.

1322-1563-2486-3490.notablePrerequisites:
Your commander on the battlefield under your control.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
1322-1563-2486-3490.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
The Servo enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to the ability granted by Master Chef, triggering Animation Module.
Holding priority, activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

967-1806-2382-2604-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Mimic Vat triggers, exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard and returning any previously exiled creatures to their owners' graveyards.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Eternal Scourge for {1}.
Prosper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Eternal Scourge, allowing it to enter the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

2059-2232-3990-4022.notablePrerequisites:
Incubation Druid has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You control at least one land that can tap for white mana.
2059-2232-3990-4022.description:
Tap Incubation Druid to cast Village Bell-Ringer.
When Village Bell-Ringer ETBs, Cloudstone Curio and Village Bell-Ringer trigger.
Resolve the Village Bell-Ringer trigger, untapping all creatures you control.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio, returning Hidden Herbalists to your hand.
Cast Hidden Herbalists for {G}{G}.
When Hidden Herbalists ETBs, Cloudstone Curio and Hidden Herbalists trigger.
Resolve the Hidden Herbalists trigger, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Village Bell-Ringer to your hand.
Repeat.

1283-1358-1978.description:
Animate Chromatic Orrery using Sydri.
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Repeat from step 2.
